CREATE Procedure CDN.MobS_EksportGrup @CentrumID INT, -- ID centrum praw struktury firmy @OpeNumer INT, -- ID mobilnego sprzedawcy @TypEksportu INT, -- Typ eksportu (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) @PackageSize INT, -- rozmiar paczki @PackageNumber INT -- numer paczki AS SET @PackageSize = @PackageSize*2
DECLARE @TimeStamp INT DECLARE @Typ_Twr SMALLINT DECLARE @Typ_GrT SMALLINT DECLARE @Typ_Knt SMALLINT DECLARE @Typ_GrK SMALLINT
SET @Typ_Twr = 16 SET @Typ_GrT = -16 SET @Typ_Knt = 32 SET @Typ_GrK = -32 SET @TimeStamp = DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(datetime,'19900101',112),CONVERT(datetime,GetDate(),112))
DECLARE @Rejony TABLE (KtOTyp SMALLINT, KtONumer INT) DECLARE @GrOTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GrONumer INT DECLARE @Dzis INT
SELECT @Dzis = DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(datetime,'18001228',112),CONVERT(datetime,GetDate(),112)) SELECT @GrOTyp=PcK_KnGETyp, @GrONumer=PcK_KnGENumer FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4
IF @GrOTyp = 944 BEGIN INSERT INTO @Rejony SELECT KtO_KntTyp, KtO_KntNumer FROM CDN.OpeKarty JOIN CDN.KntOpiekun ON Ope_PrcNumer=KtO_PrcNumer WHERE Ope_GIDNumer=@OpeNumer AND (KtO_KntTyp=948 OR (KtO_KntTyp=32 AND @Dzis BETWEEN KtO_DataOd AND KtO_DataDo)); END
UPDATE CDN.PicoKonfig SET PcK_TSSynchrGrup = @TimeStamp WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4
SELECT DISTINCT IDENTITY(INT,1,1) AS Rank, TwG_GIDTyp, TwG_GIDNumer, TwG_GrOTyp, TwG_GrONumer, CASE WHEN TwG_GIDTyp=@Typ_GrT THEN TwG_Kod ELSE '' END As TwG_Kod, CASE WHEN TwG_GIDTyp=@Typ_GrT THEN TwG_Nazwa ELSE '' END As TwG_Nazwa INTO #TempTwG FROM CDN.TwrGrupy JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID WHERE (TwG_GIDTyp = @Typ_GrT AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.TwrGrupy WHERE TwG_GIDTyp = @Typ_GrT AND TwG_CzasModyfikacji >= CASE WHEN @TypEksportu = 0 THEN ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrGrupPTW,0) ELSE 0 END)) OR (TwG_GIDTyp = @Typ_Twr AND TwG_GIDNumer > 0 AND ISNULL(TwG_CzasModyfikacji, 0) >= CASE WHEN @TypEksportu = 0 THEN ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrGrupPTW,0) ELSE 0 END) AND (EXISTS(Select * FROM CDN.TwrLinki where TwL_GIDNumer = TwG_GIDNumer AND TwL_GRONumer = PcK_TwGNumer) OR TwG_GIDTyp = -16) ORDER BY TwG_GIDTyp, TwG_GIDNumer
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TempTwG
DELETE FROM #TempTwG WHERE Rank <= @packageSize * (@packageNumber - 1) OR Rank > @packageSize * @packageNumber
SELECT * FROM #TempTwG
SELECT DISTINCT IDENTITY(INT,1,1) AS Rank, KnG_GIDTyp, KnG_GIDNumer, KnG_GrOTyp, KnG_GrONumer, CASE WHEN KnG_GIDTyp=@Typ_GrK THEN KnG_Akronim ELSE '' END As KnG_Akronim INTO #TempKnG FROM CDN.KntGrupy JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID WHERE (KnG_GIDTyp = @Typ_GrK AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.KntGrupy WHERE KnG_GIDTyp = @Typ_GrK AND KnG_CzasModyfikacji >= CASE WHEN @TypEksportu = 0 THEN ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrGrupPTW,0) ELSE 0 END )) OR (KnG_GIDTyp = @Typ_Knt AND KnG_GIDNumer > 0 AND ISNULL(KnG_CzasModyfikacji,0) >= CASE WHEN @TypEksportu = 0 THEN ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrGrupPTW,0)ELSE 0 END ) AND (( EXISTS(Select * FROM CDN.KnTLinki where KnL_GIDNumer = KnG_GIDNumer AND KnL_GRONumer = PcK_KnGENumer) OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.KntLinki JOIN CDN.KntKarty ON Knt_GIDTyp=KnL_GIDTyp AND Knt_GIDNumer=KnL_GIDNumer WHERE KnL_GIDNumer = KnG_GIDNumer AND KnL_GIDTyp = KnG_GIDTyp AND (Knt_RegionCRM IN (SELECT KtONumer FROM @Rejony WHERE KtOTyp=948) OR Knt_GIDNumer IN (SELECT KtONumer FROM @Rejony WHERE KtOTyp=32) )) ) OR KnG_GIDTyp = -32) ORDER BY KnG_GIDTyp, KnG_GIDNumer
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TempKnG
DELETE FROM #TempKnG WHERE Rank <= @packageSize * (@packageNumber - 1) OR Rank > @packageSize * @packageNumber
SELECT * FROM #TempKnG
